Assumption difference with lemma-quasi-coherence-scalar-restriction (statement 1844-1853, not carded because its statement carries a citation whose bibliography is missing from the snapshot): this card assumes additionally that f is affine and concludes the categorical equivalence; that statement needs only a quasi-coherent algebra on a scheme. Conclusion difference: the final assertion of this card is the conclusion of that lemma, while the equivalence of categories is a different conclusion; the overlap is confined to the author's first proof sentence, which disposes of that assertion by citation and is recorded here for transparency.
